slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Your README is part of the interview
slides.subtitle: For take-home assignments, the repo story matters.

slides.title: Why it matters
slides.body: A hiring manager may only have a few minutes before the interview. They may read the README before the code.

slides.title: Show the work
slides.body: Explain the assignment, product scope, data sources, safety boundaries, and how to run the project.

slides.title: Show engineering
slides.body: List tests, evals, monitoring, known limitations, and next improvements.

slides.title: Be honest
slides.body: If code was AI-generated, say what you reviewed, what remains weak, and how you would improve it.

slides.ctaText: follow for practical AI engineering notes
